title: WNBA: Caitlin Clark Faces Suspension After Technical Foul
description: Reports indicate Caitlin Clark faces a one-game suspension after receiving an eighth technical foul during a game against the Sky.

sections.heading: Suspension Reports
paragraphs: According to The New York Times, Caitlin Clark earns a one-game suspension after her eighth technical foul. Bleacher Report reports that Clark faces suspension for her eighth technical foul after contact with a referee during the Fever vs. Sky game. USA Today also confirms that Clark picked up her eighth technical of the season versus the Sky and faces a suspension.

sections.heading: Match Details
paragraphs: The incident involving the technical foul took place during a game between the Fever and the Sky, according to Bleacher Report. USA Today identifies the opponent as the Sky in their report on the eighth technical foul.
